# Project skeleton

A minimal, reproducible starting point for an R research project: a flat folder
layout, a curated `.gitignore`, pinned packages with renv, data checks with
checkmate and testthat, and a place for external data with pins. Clone it,
delete what you do not need, and start working.

## Getting started

1. Clone this repository and rename the folder to your project name.
2. Open the folder in R (the empty `.here` file marks the project root).
3. Run `renv::init()` once to create your own `renv.lock` (see `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md`).
4. Replace the placeholders in `CITATION.cff` and `LICENSE`.
5. Put raw data in `data/raw/` and edit the numbered scripts in `scripts/`.

## Folder structure

```{r folder-tree, echo = FALSE, comment = "", comment = ""}
fs::dir_tree(path = ".", recurse = TRUE)
```

Details, rules and recipes are in [PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md](PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md).

## Optional add-on branches

Optional extras live in separate branches you can merge when needed:
`githooks`, `zenodo` and `website` (all coming soon). You will not see them
unless you look for them: `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` explains how to fetch,
inspect and merge each one.
